'''The Retreat''' was a settlement in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. It was founded by [[Rel Harsol]], a former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Cratala]], an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Scientist/Legends|cyberneticist]], and other survivors after their [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] crashed on the planet.
